title: Pierson v. Post (N.Y. Sup. Ct. 1805): does pursuit of a wild animal confer property in it?
question: Did Post, by pursuing the fox with hounds on unowned land, acquire property in it, so that Pierson's killing and carrying it off was an actionable wrong?
